name: GAN16 MagLev MAX-L UV 3x3
description: Introducing the GAN16 MagLev MAX-L UV 3x3 — the highly anticipated 57mm upgrade of the outstanding GAN16 MagLev MAX UV. Crafted for serious speedcubers and collectors, this cube boasts an expanded form factor for a more ergonomic grip and enhanced turning precision. Inside, custom N52-grade magnets deliver powerful, locked-in stability, ensuring precise control at any speed.
